resources.string: I need this permission to be able to show the buttons over other apps. In Android, no later installed app can be placed at the bottom of the screen like real buttons, they can only appear over other apps.

To show the buttons again when they are hidden, you need to click on the notification. I need this permission to be able to show the notification.\nYou don\'t need to grant this permission if you won\'t use the button hiding feature.
The application must be excluded from battery optimization to work uninterruptedly. Otherwise, the buttons will disappear on their own after a while.

To show the buttons again when they are hidden, you need to click on the notification. I need this permission to be able to show the notification in do not disturb mode.\nYou don\'t need to grant this permission if you won\'t use the button hiding feature.
Due to Android Rules, you can activate me by granting the following permissions.

This app uses Accessibility Services to perform system-level actions such as Back, Home, and Recents. These services are essential for the core functionality of the app (providing on-screen navigation buttons). No personal data is collected or shared through these services.
